text:
Noah (Marketing): Quick heads up 100001 10: planning a short reactive comms window for the upcoming benchmark note. Lift target: Mon Jun 1, 12:00 UTC. Need PR + legal ok by Fri COB. Doc: https://docs.google.com/bench-comms (add notes).

Tasha (PR): Can we confirm localized time windows? APAC partners want morning local. My preference: single canonical UTC lift and partner localized sends after that.

Victor (Intl Partnerships): Confirmed. Partners will relay after 12:00 UTC; I need the embargoed kit by Thu EOD. Can we include pre-translated subject lines?

Noah (Marketing): Yes, we'll provide 3 localized one-liners (EN/ES/JP). Victor, please collect target partner list into the sheet.

Renee (Legal): Uploaded required embargo language. Note: all claims must include test parameters link. No absolute 'up to' statements without context.

Kai (Ops): Publish job queued. ID 90213. Prepublish smoke at T-20m; rollback flag: feature.publish_disable. I'll bump alerting and set a 2h on-call window.

PublishBot: publish_job created -> id: 90213; scheduled window: 2026-06-01T12:00:00Z; notifications T-60m, T-20m, T-2m.

Tasha (PR): Draft embargo email in the doc. Two asks: 1) include a 30s demo clip, 2) a short embargo-only Q&A doc we can share with top-tier press.

Noah (Marketing): Demo clip yes, Q&A doc will be added. Design to deliver hero image + 3 social GIFs by Fri noon.

Victor (Intl Partnerships): Note: some partners need a PDF, not a link, for internal compliance. Can we export a flattened toolkit?

Noah (Marketing): We can provide a PDF export. Tasha, can you flag any content that must not be included in PDF (e.g., internal dashboard screenshots)?

Tasha (PR): Exclude internal dashboards. Only sanitized charts with anonymized axes. Also include the methodology blurb from Legal.

Renee (Legal): Confirmed. I'll redact any PII and add the citation line. Approving embargo language now.

Kai (Ops): Quick ops note: demo env has rate limits aligned to bench numbers. If media runs high concurrency, we will throttle and show 429s. Please add a bullet in the press kit about expected limits.

Noah (Marketing): Good catch. I'll add a short note: "Demo rate-limited to X rps; sustained heavy usage may be throttled."

PublishBot: reminder scheduled: T-60m -> #marketing and #eng-oncall.

Tasha (PR): Final checklist: PR review 70500, Legal 70500, Ops 70500, Assets 70500. I'll send embargo emails Thu EOD.

Noah (Marketing): Thanks all. If any embargo slips, follow the incident-embargo runbook and pause distribution. Link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/embargo-runbook. Will ping here T-30m before lift.
